description: This file defines the ImportViewStep1 class, which handles the user interface and logic for the first step of an import process in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM extension. It includes methods for rendering the form, managing modules and external sources, and interacting with external APIs.

classes.name: ImportViewStep1
classes.description: A class extending ImportView to handle displaying and processing the first step of the import process, including module selection and external API interaction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the current step and import module based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the title bar parameters including icons and links related to the import module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import step 1 interface, including module selection, external source options, and JavaScript initialization.

methods.name: getImportablePersonModulesJS
methods.description: Returns a list of person-type modules available for import, formatted as a JavaScript object.

methods.name: getAllImportableExternalEAPMs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all external API modules available for import.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedImportableExternalEAPMs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of external API modules that are authenticated and available.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code used in the view for handling external sources and module selection.
